title: Netflix Is Using AI to Read Your Mind
full_monologue: **Netflix Is Using AI to Read Your Mind**. It’s not sci-fi — it’s happening now. By analyzing your watch history, pause points, and even how fast you scroll, Netflix’s AI predicts what you’ll love next. But here’s the twist: it’s not just about what you watch — it’s about what you *don’t* watch. They’re learning your mind before you even realize it. And now, they’re using that data to personalize every detail of your streaming experience. Creepy? Maybe. Genius? Definitely. What do you think — is this the future of entertainment or a privacy nightmare? Let me know below.
